001package com.streamConverter.controller;
002
003import com.streamConverter.command.EnhancedCommandFactory;
004import com.streamConverter.factory.FactoryConfiguration;
005import java.util.HashMap;
006import java.util.Map;
007import java.util.Objects;
008import org.slf4j.Logger;
009import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
010
011/**
012 * Factory for creating and managing stream controllers with CommandFactory integration.
013 *
014 * <p>This factory provides centralized controller creation and management, supporting:
015 *
016 * <ul>
017 *   <li>Controller creation based on data types and processing requirements
018 *   <li>CommandFactory integration for unified command and controller creation
019 *   <li>Type-safe OutputType enum for eliminating hardcoded string literals
020 *   <li>Controller registry for reuse and management
021 *   <li>Automatic controller selection based on input/output types
022 *   <li>Configuration validation and optimization
023 *   <li>Detailed logging control through CommandFactory integration
024 * </ul>
025 *
026 * <p>The factory pattern enhances the Controller architecture by providing a single entry point for
027 * external systems to obtain appropriate controllers while leveraging the existing CommandFactory
028 * infrastructure for consistent command creation and logging.
029 *
030 * <p>Usage examples:
031 *
032 * <pre>
033 * // Get controller by data types (string-based)
034 * IStreamController controller = ControllerFactory.getController("CSV", "JSON_PROPERTY");
035 *
036 * // Get controller with OutputType enum (type-safe)
037 * IStreamController controller = ControllerFactory.getController("CSV", OutputType.JSON_PROPERTY);
038 *
039 * // Get controller with CommandFactory integration and OutputType enum
040 * IStreamController controller = ControllerFactory.createWithCommandFactory("CSV", OutputType.JSON_FORMATTED, true);
041 *
042 * // Get controller with specific configuration
043 * IStreamController controller = ControllerFactory.getCsvController()
044 *     .forColumnExtraction("name");
045 *
046 * // Register custom controller
047 * ControllerFactory.registerController("CUSTOM_CSV", "CUSTOM_OUTPUT", customController);
048 * </pre>
049 *
050 * @author StreamConverter Team
051 * @version 1.0
052 * @since 1.0
053 */
054public class ControllerFactory {
055
056  private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ControllerFactory.class);
057
058  /** Prevent instantiation. */
059  private ControllerFactory() {}
060
061  /** Registry of controllers by type combination */
062  private static final Map<String, IStreamController> controllerRegistry = new HashMap<>();
063
064  /** Registry of controller builders by input type */
065  private static final Map<String, ControllerBuilder> builderRegistry = new HashMap<>();
066
067  /** Enhanced command factory for optimized command creation */
068  private static final EnhancedCommandFactory commandFactory =
069      EnhancedCommandFactory.createProductionInstance();
070
071  static {
072    // Initialize default builders with CommandFactory integration
073    builderRegistry.put("CSV", new CsvControllerBuilder());
074    builderRegistry.put("JSON", new JsonControllerBuilder());
075
076    log.info(
077        "Initialized ControllerFactory with enhanced CommandFactory integration for optimized performance");
078  }
079
080  /**
081   * Gets a controller for the specified input and output data types using OutputType enum.
082   *
083   * <p>This method provides type-safe controller creation by using the OutputType enum instead of
084   * string literals.
085   *
086   * @param inputType the expected input data type (e.g., "CSV", "JSON", "XML")
087   * @param outputType the expected output data type as enum
088   * @return appropriate controller, or null if none can be created
089   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if input parameters are invalid
090   */
091  public static IStreamController getController(String inputType, OutputType outputType) {
092    Objects.requireNonNull(outputType, "Output type cannot be null");
093    return getController(inputType, outputType.getValue());
094  }
095
096  /**
097   * Gets a controller for the specified input and output data types.
098   *
099   * <p>This method attempts to find an appropriate controller from the registry or create a new one
100   * using the available builders.
101   *
102   * @param inputType the expected input data type (e.g., "CSV", "JSON", "XML")
103   * @param outputType the expected output data type (e.g., "CSV_COLUMN", "JSON_PROPERTY")
104   * @return appropriate controller, or null if none can be created
105   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if input parameters are invalid
106   */
107  public static IStreamController getController(String inputType, String outputType) {
108    Objects.requireNonNull(inputType, "Input type cannot be null");
109    Objects.requireNonNull(outputType, "Output type cannot be null");
110
111    String key = createRegistryKey(inputType, outputType);
112
113    // Check registry first
114    IStreamController cachedController = controllerRegistry.get(key);
115    if (cachedController != null) {
116      log.debug("Found cached controller for {} → {}", inputType, outputType);
117      return cachedController;
118    }
119
120    // Try to create using builders
121    ControllerBuilder builder = builderRegistry.get(inputType);
122    if (builder != null) {
123      IStreamController controller = builder.createForOutputType(outputType);
124      if (controller != null) {
125        log.info("Created controller for {} → {} using builder", inputType, outputType);
126        // Cache for future use
127        controllerRegistry.put(key, controller);
128        return controller;
129      }
130    }
131
132    log.warn("No controller available for {} → {}", inputType, outputType);
133    return null;
134  }
135
136  /**
137   * Gets a CSV controller builder for advanced configuration.
138   *
139   * @return CSV controller builder
140   */
141  public static CsvControllerBuilder getCsvController() {
142    return new CsvControllerBuilder();
143  }
144
145  /**
146   * Gets a JSON controller builder for advanced configuration.
147   *
148   * @return JSON controller builder
149   */
150  public static JsonControllerBuilder getJsonController() {
151    return new JsonControllerBuilder();
152  }
153
154  /**
155   * Creates a controller using CommandFactory-style configuration with OutputType enum.
156   *
157   * <p>This method provides type-safe controller creation while leveraging the existing
158   * CommandFactory infrastructure for unified command and controller creation.
159   *
160   * @param inputType the expected input data type
161   * @param outputType the expected output data type as enum
162   * @param enableDetailedLogging whether to enable detailed logging for created commands
163   * @return appropriate controller with CommandFactory integration, or null if none can be created
164   */
165  public static IStreamController createWithCommandFactory(
166      String inputType, OutputType outputType, boolean enableDetailedLogging) {
167    Objects.requireNonNull(outputType, "Output type cannot be null");
168    return createWithCommandFactory(inputType, outputType.getValue(), enableDetailedLogging);
169  }
170
171  /**
172   * Creates a controller using CommandFactory-style configuration.
173   *
174   * <p>This method leverages the existing CommandFactory infrastructure to provide a unified
175   * approach to both controller and command creation.
176   *
177   * @param inputType the expected input data type
178   * @param outputType the expected output data type
179   * @param enableDetailedLogging whether to enable detailed logging for created commands
180   * @return appropriate controller with CommandFactory integration, or null if none can be created
181   */
182  public static IStreamController createWithCommandFactory(
183      String inputType, String outputType, boolean enableDetailedLogging) {
184    Objects.requireNonNull(inputType, "Input type cannot be null");
185    Objects.requireNonNull(outputType, "Output type cannot be null");
186
187    String key = createRegistryKey(inputType, outputType);
188
189    // Check registry first
190    IStreamController cachedController = controllerRegistry.get(key);
191    if (cachedController != null) {
192      log.debug(
193          "Found cached CommandFactory-integrated controller for {} → {}", inputType, outputType);
194      return cachedController;
195    }
196
197    // Create using enhanced builders with CommandFactory integration
198    ControllerBuilder builder = builderRegistry.get(inputType);
199    if (builder instanceof CommandFactoryAwareBuilder) {
200      CommandFactoryAwareBuilder enhancedBuilder = (CommandFactoryAwareBuilder) builder;
201      IStreamController controller =
202          enhancedBuilder.createWithCommandFactory(outputType, enableDetailedLogging);
203      if (controller != null) {
204        log.info(
205            "Created CommandFactory-integrated controller for {} → {} with detailed logging: {}",
206            inputType,
207            outputType,
208            enableDetailedLogging);
209        controllerRegistry.put(key, controller);
210        return controller;
211      }
212    }
213
214    // Fallback to standard creation
215    return getController(inputType, outputType);
216  }
217
218  /**
219   * Registers a custom controller for specific input/output type combination.
220   *
221   * @param inputType the input data type
222   * @param outputType the output data type
223   * @param controller the controller to register
224   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if parameters are invalid
225   */
226  public static void registerController(
227      String inputType, String outputType, IStreamController controller) {
228    Objects.requireNonNull(inputType, "Input type cannot be null");
229    Objects.requireNonNull(outputType, "Output type cannot be null");
230    Objects.requireNonNull(controller, "Controller cannot be null");
231
232    String key = createRegistryKey(inputType, outputType);
233    controllerRegistry.put(key, controller);
234
235    log.info(
236        "Registered custom controller for {} → {}: {}",
237        inputType,
238        outputType,
239        controller.getClass().getSimpleName());
240  }
241
242  /**
243   * Registers a custom controller builder for a specific input type.
244   *
245   * @param inputType the input data type
246   * @param builder the controller builder to register
247   * @throws IllegalArgumentException if parameters are invalid
248   */
249  public static void registerBuilder(String inputType, ControllerBuilder builder) {
250    Objects.requireNonNull(inputType, "Input type cannot be null");
251    Objects.requireNonNull(builder, "Builder cannot be null");
252
253    builderRegistry.put(inputType, builder);
254
255    log.info(
256        "Registered custom builder for input type {}: {}",
257        inputType,
258        builder.getClass().getSimpleName());
259  }
260
261  /**
262   * Creates a controller with optimized CommandFactory integration. This method addresses Issue
263   * #124 by reducing redundancy and improving integration.
264   *
265   * @param inputType the expected input data type
266   * @param outputType the expected output data type as enum
267   * @param config factory configuration for optimization
268   * @return optimized controller with enhanced integration
269   */
270  public static IStreamController createOptimized(
271      String inputType, OutputType outputType, FactoryConfiguration config) {
272    Objects.requireNonNull(outputType, "Output type cannot be null");
273    Objects.requireNonNull(config, "Factory configuration cannot be null");
274
275    String key = createRegistryKey(inputType, outputType.getValue());
276
277    // Check cache first
278    IStreamController cached = controllerRegistry.get(key);
279    if (cached != null && config.isCachingEnabled()) {
280      log.debug("Retrieved cached optimized controller for {} → {}", inputType, outputType);
281      return cached;
282    }
283
284    // Create using optimized command factory
285    ControllerBuilder builder = builderRegistry.get(inputType);
286    if (builder instanceof CommandFactoryAwareBuilder) {
287      CommandFactoryAwareBuilder enhancedBuilder = (CommandFactoryAwareBuilder) builder;
288
289      // Use enhanced command factory for better performance
290      IStreamController controller =
291          enhancedBuilder.createWithCommandFactory(
292              outputType.getValue(), config.isDetailedLoggingEnabled());
293
294      if (controller != null) {
295        log.info(
296            "Created optimized controller for {} → {} with enhanced CommandFactory integration",
297            inputType,
298            outputType);
299
300        if (config.isCachingEnabled()) {
301          controllerRegistry.put(key, controller);
302        }
303        return controller;
304      }
305    }
306
307    // Fallback to standard creation
308    return getController(inputType, outputType);
309  }
310
311  /**
312   * Gets the enhanced command factory instance used by this controller factory. This provides
313   * access to the optimized command creation infrastructure.
314   *
315   * @return enhanced command factory instance
316   */
317  public static EnhancedCommandFactory getCommandFactory() {
318    return commandFactory;
319  }

321  /**
322   * Gets all registered controller types.
323   *
324   * @return array of registered input → output type combinations
325   */
326  public static String[] getRegisteredTypes() {
327    return controllerRegistry.keySet().toArray(new String[0]);
328  }
329
330  /**
331   * Clears all registered controllers and builders.
332   *
333   * <p>This method is primarily for testing purposes.
334   */
335  public static void clearRegistry() {
336    controllerRegistry.clear();
337    builderRegistry.clear();
338    log.info("Controller registry cleared");
339  }
340
341  /** Creates a registry key from input and output types. */
342  private static String createRegistryKey(String inputType, String outputType) {
343    return inputType + " → " + outputType;
344  }
345
346  /** Interface for controller builders. */
347  public interface ControllerBuilder {
348    /**
349     * Creates a controller for the specified output type.
350     *
351     * @param outputType the desired output type
352     * @return appropriate controller, or null if not supported
353     */
354    IStreamController createForOutputType(String outputType);
355  }
356
357  /** Interface for builders that can integrate with CommandFactory. */
358  public interface CommandFactoryAwareBuilder extends ControllerBuilder {
359    /**
360     * Creates a controller with CommandFactory integration.
361     *
362     * @param outputType the desired output type
363     * @param enableDetailedLogging whether to enable detailed logging
364     * @return appropriate controller with CommandFactory integration, or null if not supported
365     */
366    IStreamController createWithCommandFactory(String outputType, boolean enableDetailedLogging);
367  }
368
369  /** Builder for CSV controllers. */
370  public static class CsvControllerBuilder implements CommandFactoryAwareBuilder {
371
372    /** Creates a new builder. */
373    public CsvControllerBuilder() {}
374
375    @Override
376    public IStreamController createForOutputType(String outputType) {
377      OutputType type = OutputType.fromString(outputType);
378      if (type != null) {
379        return createForOutputType(type);
380      }
381
382      // Fallback for unknown string types
383      log.warn("Unknown output type for CSV controller: {}", outputType);
384      return null;
385    }
386
387    /**
388     * Creates a controller for the specified OutputType enum.
389     *
390     * @param outputType the desired output type as enum
391     * @return appropriate controller, or null if not supported
392     */
393    public IStreamController createForOutputType(OutputType outputType) {
394      switch (outputType) {
395        case CSV_COLUMN:
396          return CsvProcessingController.forColumnExtraction("default");
397        case PROCESSED_DATA:
398          return CsvProcessingController.forComplexProcessing("default", "default-processor");
399        case CSV:
400          return CsvProcessingController.forPassThrough();
401        default:
402          log.warn("Unsupported output type for CSV controller: {}", outputType);
403          return null;
404      }
405    }
406
407    /**
408     * Creates a controller for column extraction.
409     *
410     * @param columnSelector column name or index to extract
411     * @return configured controller
412     */
413    public CsvProcessingController forColumnExtraction(String columnSelector) {
414      return CsvProcessingController.forColumnExtraction(columnSelector);
415    }
416
417    /**
418     * Creates a controller for complex processing.
419     *
420     * @param columnSelector column name or index
421     * @param processorId processor ID
422     * @return configured controller
423     */
424    public CsvProcessingController forComplexProcessing(String columnSelector, String processorId) {
425      return CsvProcessingController.forComplexProcessing(columnSelector, processorId);
426    }
427
428    /**
429     * Creates a controller for pass-through processing.
430     *
431     * @return configured controller
432     */
433    public CsvProcessingController forPassThrough() {
434      return CsvProcessingController.forPassThrough();
435    }
436
437    @Override
438    public IStreamController createWithCommandFactory(
439        String outputType, boolean enableDetailedLogging) {
440      // Create controller using standard method, as AbstractStreamController
441      // already integrates with CommandFactory for command creation
442      IStreamController controller = createForOutputType(outputType);
443
444      if (controller != null) {
445        log.debug(
446            "Created CSV controller with CommandFactory integration for output type: {}, detailed logging: {}",
447            outputType,
448            enableDetailedLogging);
449      }
450
451      return controller;
452    }
453  }
454
455  /** Builder for JSON controllers. */
456  public static class JsonControllerBuilder implements CommandFactoryAwareBuilder {
457
458    /** Creates a new builder. */
459    public JsonControllerBuilder() {}
460
461    @Override
462    public IStreamController createForOutputType(String outputType) {
463      OutputType type = OutputType.fromString(outputType);
464      if (type != null) {
465        return createForOutputType(type);
466      }
467
468      // Fallback for unknown string types
469      log.warn("Unknown output type for JSON controller: {}", outputType);
470      return null;
471    }
472
473    /**
474     * Creates a controller for the specified OutputType enum.
475     *
476     * @param outputType the desired output type as enum
477     * @return appropriate controller, or null if not supported
478     */
479    public IStreamController createForOutputType(OutputType outputType) {
480      switch (outputType) {
481        case JSON_PROPERTY:
482          return JsonProcessingController.forPropertyExtraction("default", false);
483        case VALIDATED_JSON_PROPERTY:
484          return JsonProcessingController.forPropertyExtraction("default", true);
485        case JSON_FORMATTED:
486          return JsonProcessingController.forFormatting();
487        case TRANSFORMED_DATA:
488          return JsonProcessingController.forTransformation("default", "default-processor");
489        default:
490          log.warn("Unsupported output type for JSON controller: {}", outputType);
491          return null;
492      }
493    }
494
495    /**
496     * Creates a controller for property extraction.
497     *
498     * @param propertyPath JSON property path
499     * @param enableValidation whether to enable validation
500     * @return configured controller
501     */
502    public JsonProcessingController forPropertyExtraction(
503        String propertyPath, boolean enableValidation) {
504      return JsonProcessingController.forPropertyExtraction(propertyPath, enableValidation);
505    }
506
507    /**
508     * Creates a controller for JSON formatting.
509     *
510     * @return configured controller
511     */

515
516    /**
517     * Creates a controller for multi-stage transformation.
518     *
519     * @param propertyPath JSON property path
520     * @param processingStages processing stage IDs
521     * @return configured controller
522     */
523    public JsonProcessingController forTransformation(
524        String propertyPath, String... processingStages) {
525      return JsonProcessingController.forTransformation(propertyPath, processingStages);
526    }
527
528    @Override
529    public IStreamController createWithCommandFactory(
530        String outputType, boolean enableDetailedLogging) {
531      // Create controller using standard method, as AbstractStreamController
532      // already integrates with CommandFactory for command creation
533      IStreamController controller = createForOutputType(outputType);
534
535      if (controller != null) {
536        log.debug(
537            "Created JSON controller with CommandFactory integration for output type: {}, detailed logging: {}",
538            outputType,
539            enableDetailedLogging);
540      }
541
542      return controller;
543    }
544  }
545}
